description: Use this when the person wants to see earlier states of their palimpalem website or go back to one. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Without restore it lists the saved versions (each is the state before a change); with restore=<id> it brings that state back, after saving the current state as a new version, so nothing is lost.

restore.description: Optional. Id of the version to bring back, from the list (e.g. 1763030000.1234).

web.description: The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.

name: versiones_web
title: Versions of my website
